claim: On May 28 2026 Stockholm sees sunrise at 3:45 am and sunset at 9:44 pm — a day length of 17 hours 58 minutes, lengthening to 18 h 8 min by May 31 as the city approaches its June 21 solstice peak of 18 h 44 min.
quote: May 28 (Thursday): Sunrise: 3:45:52 am; Sunset: 9:44:10 pm; Day length: 17 hours, 58 minutes ... May 31 ... Day length: 18 hours, 8 minutes

claim: Stockholm's 'white nights' run roughly mid-May to early August: the sun dips below the horizon but the sky never goes fully black, holding a soft blue-grey twilight bright enough to see by without streetlights.
quote: The sky remains a soft blue-gray, and even around midnight there is enough light to see clearly without streetlights ... White nights typically last from mid-May to early August

claim: Late-May Stockholm typically delivers daily highs of 60–69 °F (16–21 °C) with overnight lows around 45–54 °F (7–12 °C); first-of-June averages climb to ~17.7 °C high / 10.5 °C low.
quote: daily high temperatures ranging from 60° to 69°F, with overnight lows between 45° and 54°F. The average high for May is 66°F with an average low of 50°F

claim: The 47th adidas Stockholm Marathon runs Saturday May 30 2026 with starts at 12:00, 12:08 and 12:16 — meaning a late-May weekend visitor will hit road closures and a busy central-city race-day atmosphere.
quote: adidas Stockholm Marathon takes place on Saturday, May 30, 2026 ... the first start at 12:00, the second start at 12:08, and the third start at 12:16

claim: Kungsträdgården's ~60 Japanese cherry trees peak around April 20 and the bloom lasts roughly two weeks — so by late May the sakura is finished, and lilacs (syrener), which flower late May into early June, take over as the city's signature spring scent.
quote: Stockholm's cherry blossoms peak between mid-April and early May 2026 ... the first buds open in the second week of April, with peak bloom around April 20th, though the display lasts approximately two weeks

claim: Midsummer's Eve falls on Friday June 19 2026 with Midsummer's Day June 20; a May 28 visitor is three weeks too early to attend, but they will see the city quietly gearing up while most actual celebrations empty into the countryside and archipelago.
quote: Midsummer's Eve 2026 is on Friday, June 19 ... Midsummer's Day 2026 is on Saturday, June 20 ... many Stockholmers leave the city to celebrate in the countryside or the archipelago

claim: Stockholm's uteservering (outdoor-terrace) season opens late April / early May and peaks June–early July with extended golden hours; floating venues like Debaser Pontonen at Hornstull run May–September.
quote: The arrival of the outdoor bar season in late April/early May is one of the most eagerly-awaited signs of summer ... Debaser Pontonen is open on the water in Hornstull from May to September

claim: Waxholmsbolaget's full archipelago summer timetable — including the North–South Line linking most outer islands — only runs June 22 to August 16 2026, so late-May visitors get reduced 'spring' service and should confirm individual island connections before committing.
quote: The North-South Line operates from June 22 – August 16 during 2026. This ferry connects with most islands on the Stockholm Archipelago Trail every day
